trial_scope.fixed: Same spectra/exponents/gain/db/converter/BSI/payload/dither/plan and before-state for all q trials.
trial_scope.search: q16 then low16/high784, floor midpoint while high-low>1 and midpoint_count<10; preserve last successful candidate. q16 not included in midpoint counter.
trial_scope.candidate_failure: Main trial capacity/BAP/quantization sentinel/group/field construction infeasible destroys trial scratch only; no candidate-level owner or clock commit.
trial_scope.fatal: Invalid preflight/plan/BSI/EMDF/provider, uncaught or unclassifiable error, or no accepted candidate retires programme.
trial_scope.converter_distinction: F11 legal negative budget/residual is converter infeasible; candidate BAP callback error/illegal BAP/domain or arithmetic error is fatal producer error, not swallowed as main-trial rejection.

acceptance_sequence: all producers and staged leaf receipts ready
complete final candidate exactly4096 and CRC residual0
suppressed source: skip IO; published source: durable append receipt
abort: Discard all staged leaf roots; preserve committed owner identities and clocks/ledger except status/fatal record. If IO began, mark whole temp artifact ABANDONED. Subsequent source/callback rejected; only programme-origin full_restart.
restart: Destroy all owners and measurement receipt, discard pending/scratch, close old temp, attempt+1, new staging identity, clocks cold, re-enter METERING. No same-attempt resume from trusted ledger or truncate.
